note: 23 PDF sheets of 595x842 whose running header prints "Team # 49630 Page N of 22", so printed page = PDF page - 1: PDF 1 is the official summary sheet with the "Team Control Number / For office use only" stub block, which is page furniture and was not measured, so no exclusion is needed; PDF 2 is the printed Contents page and references fill PDF 22-23 (printed 21-22). 15 measured regions on 12 pages and every one an exhibit: 9 table rows and 6 figure rows, nothing excluded and nothing unaccounted. A pymupdf sweep finds exactly 6 embedded raster images, one per figure, and no unmeasured vector artwork on any page, so the census is complete. Numbering is conventional throughout - all 9 tables print "Table N:" and all 6 figures "Figure N:" - and all 15 captions sit below their exhibit; Tables 2, 3 and 4 close their captions with a full stop where the other six tables and all six figures do not. The nine tables are boxed grids of the same house form (outer box, vertical separators, a rule under every row) except Table 8, which is ruled only horizontally and records booktabs with that deviation in its note; only Table 5's two Weight columns are decimal-aligned, every other numeric column is right-aligned. Table 3 and Table 4 are a near-duplicate pair: both captions read "CI Value" while their head groups read "CR Value" and "ACR Value", their body codes are identical, and both need an unexplained band legend printed under the grid to be readable at all. Tables 6 and 7 share a caption stem but only Table 6 carries an Error[%] column. Units are handled four different ways inside one paper - in the head band (Tables 3, 4, and Table 6's Error[%]), in the row stubs (Tables 7, 8, 9), in a "Unit:m³/cap." note under the grid (Table 2), and nowhere at all (Tables 1, 5). Every one of the six figures is pasted raster art rather than a drawn vector, and of four kinds: Figure 1 a factor tree with double-headed edges, Figure 2 an Excel dot plot with eight in-place country labels whose y-axis title is clipped to "PSM" plus a stray bracket, Figure 3 a third-party UNEP choropleth carrying its own sources and credit lines inside the image, and Figures 4, 5 and 6 Excel line charts with their legends below the plot area, Figure 4's y-axis title clipped to a bare "ability". Citation is dense but loose: Figures 2 and 3 are each named five times, Tables 6 and 7 three times each (once jointly as "Table 6 & 7"), Table 8 twice, and only Table 1 is never pointed at, even though its caption shares a page with the section it serves. The context extractor stitched Table 6's and Table 7's page images into their neighbouring sentences and appended the body line "& ACR=2.52)" to Table 9's caption; every caption here is quoted from the text layer line itself, not from that stitching.

题注位置逐行按纸面判：15 个展品的题注全部排在图或表的正下方（position=below），P4 到 P20 没有一处题注在网格之上。[caption.position]
表格线型按目视归类，不按默认：9 张表里 8 张是带外框与列分隔线的 boxed，唯 Table 8 只有通栏横线、无竖线与外框，记 booktabs 并在该行备注里写明它逐行加横线这一偏离。[table.rule_style]
单位位置四种写法都照实记：Table 3/4 与 Table 6 的 Error[%] 写在表头（units_in_header=true），Table 7/8/9 写在行首标签里（false），Table 2 单独在网格下方印 "Unit:m³/cap."（false），Table 1 与 Table 5 完全没有单位。[table.units_in_header]
同题注不同表要照原样保留：Table 3 与 Table 4 的题注都是 "CI Value"，而两表表头组分别印 "CR Value" 与 "ACR Value"，两表表体数值又完全相同，因此记两条独立展品并在备注里点明题注与表头不一致。[caption.verbatim]
引用次数按编号出现次数逐处数，不按句子数：Figure 2 与 Figure 3 各 5 次（Figure 3 有一次落在 P13 的回指），Table 6 与 Table 7 各 3 次（含 P16 那句 "Table 6 & 7"），Table 8 2 次，Table 4 在同一行出现 2 次。[mention.count]
